_comment: Approved group entities for Consignee validation (validation/consignee.py). Add new legal entities here as they're onboarded - never hardcode them in code. Names are normalized (case/punctuation/legal-suffix insensitive) before comparison.
_abbreviations_note: ARY/ARB/ARV are this business's own internal abbreviations for its subsidiaries - ARY = Aria Yangon, ARB = Aria Bago, ARV = Aria Vina. Real documents (e.g. OCR'd Delivery Receipts) commonly show only the abbreviation, not the full legal name - this is why the consignee check also accepts a first-token match, not just the full name.
_note: This is a sanitized example with fictional company names, illustrating the shape of the real config. Copy to eo_entities.json and fill in your own group's real entity names - eo_entities.json itself is gitignored so real values never get committed.
